hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a bounded x2*x5 interaction: residual is about +0.2 when x2 and x5 have the same sign and about -0.2 when they have opposite signs.
rationale: All ten residuals match sign(x2*x5): rows 1,2,3,4,6,9 have positive products (+0.29 to +3.1) and residuals of +0.203 to +0.208, while rows 0,5,7,8 have negative products (-0.72 to -2.9) and residuals of about -0.204. The residual size is essentially independent of product magnitude (row 4 with product 0.29 matches row 3 with 3.1), so the term saturates quickly.
